Ếch Xanh is a must-go restaurant!
Jan 2026 • Business
Ếch Xanh Restaurant is an excellent place for anyone who loves delicious and authentic food. The atmosphere is clean, cozy, and very welcoming, making it perfect for family meals or gatherings with friends. The frog dishes are especially outstanding, cooked with rich flavors and fresh ingredients that show great care and skill. The menu is diverse, offering many tasty options at reasonable prices. The staff are friendly, attentive, and always ready to help, which makes the dining experience even better. Overall, Ếch Xanh Restaurant is a wonderful choice and highly recommended for great food and service.

Perfect experience
Dec 2025 • Friends
The green frog dishes at this restaurant are quite impressive, with fresh ingredients and careful preparation. The frog meat is tender yet firm, not mushy and without any unpleasant smell, which makes it very enjoyable to eat. The lemongrass chili stir-fried frog is flavorful, aromatic, and slightly spicy, pairing perfectly with steamed rice. The frog porridge is served hot, generous in portion, and well-seasoned, making it a comforting choice for dinner. Service is quick and friendly, and the food is served without long waiting time. Prices are reasonable for the quality, suitable for dining with friends or family.
